Title: Baking Cookies
Content: A student is following a recipe to bake some cookies. The recipe is shown below.

:ibox:• `1` `text(cup)` butter
• `1` `text(cup)` white sugar
• `1` `text(cup)` brown sugar
• `2` eggs
• `2` `text(teaspoons)` vanilla extract
• `3` `text(cups)` flour
• `1` teaspoon baking soda
• `2` `text(teaspoons)` hot water
• `1/2` `text(teaspoon)` salt
• `2` `text(cups)` chocolate chips
• `1` `text(cup)` chopped walnuts

:ibox:`1`. Mix the white sugar, brown sugar, and butter until smooth.
`2`. Stir the eggs and vanilla extract into the mixture.
`3`. Mix the baking soda in the hot water until the water is clear and then add it to the mixture.
`4`. Stir in the salt, flour, chocolate chips, and walnuts until the cookie dough is formed.
`5`. Bake the cookie dough in an oven for `10` `text(minutes)` at `350text(°F)`.
